title: Connecting the Dots · Research Release RR2 · Post-Reveal Evidence Consolidation
description: Second citable scientific dataset release of Connecting the Dots. Incorporates ICANN's official 7 October 2026 Reveal Day statistics (1,615 active applications; 481 applicant organizations; 263 preliminary identical-string contention sets), with separately labelled secondary 2026 index coverage (980 primary strings; 1,608 primary-string application records plus six variant-only records). Includes reproducible historical 2000/2004/2012 application evidence and dated IANA records. Counts across submission, payment, official and secondary datasets represent distinct stages or sources. The public 2026 APS application-level corpus is not claimed complete. Release RR1 and its DOI remain immutable.
